critical_code_review_comments: window.__auctionShowInit relies on window.__asQueue captured by the top shim, which only populates when document.readyState !== 'loading'. It works today because Show.vue injects the script in onMounted (readyState 'complete'), but if the script is ever added to the Blade <head>/body with defer during initial parse, __asQueue stays empty and remount init becomes a no-op. Consider registering init callbacks explicitly instead of intercepting document.addEventListener.
Show.vue still uses inline onclick strings with interpolated image URLs (:onclick="`switchImg(this,'${img.url}')`") - a quote in a URL breaks/injects JS (pre-existing).
BidController@store broadcast(new BidPlaced($bid)) is still unguarded; only safe because BROADCAST_CONNECTION=log (pre-existing, not retested).

rca_of_the_issue: Previous crash was caused by re-injecting a classic script with top-level let/const on every Inertia remount. The fix (inject once, expose window.__auctionShowInit/__auctionShowCleanup, clear timerInt in cleanup) resolves it: verified no SyntaxError on remount, exactly one polling interval after return, and correct per-auction countdown.
